Terms of Service

Last updated: October 2, 2026

By using Vertex, you agree to these terms. They are short and plain.

Using Vertex

Vertex has no ads. You can use it for personal, school, and work purposes. Do not use it to harm others or to break the law.

An independent project

Vertex is not affiliated with or endorsed by Texas Instruments. TI-84 Plus CE and TI-OS are trademarks or property of Texas Instruments. Vertex uses these names only to say what the emulator runs.

Your ROM

Vertex does not provide, host, or link to ROM files. You need a ROM from a calculator you own, and you must dump it yourself. Do not share or upload ROM files. Vertex keeps your ROM in your browser and nowhere else.

Open source

Vertex is open source under the MIT license. The emulator is CEmu, which uses the GPLv3 license. The footer links to the source code for both.

No warranty, and exams

Vertex comes as is, with no warranty. It can contain bugs. It is not an approved calculator for any exam, so check your exam rules before you use any calculator, including this one.

Changes

We may change these terms. The current version is always on this page.
